Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales and use tax exemption for clay targets purchased by nonprofit gun clubs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a sales and use tax exemption for claytargets purchased by nonprofit gun clubs; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; creatinga new section; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of claytargets purchased by a nonprofit gun club for use in providing theactivity of clay target shooting for a fee. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the use p. 1 SB 5831by a nonprofit gun club of clay targets that are provided whileconducting the activity of clay target shooting for a fee.
This act applies retroactively as well asprospectively; however, taxpayers may not seek a refund for sales oruse taxes that have already been paid.
